findings.subject: Morse–Smale compactness and differential squared zero

findings.subject: Reeb graph for nonorientable surface

findings.subject: Morse homology versus singular homology
findings.action: AT cites geometric incidence equality explicitly and keeps equal critical-value lemma; DG proves a detailed handle-filtration comparison, gluing and orientation

findings.subject: Morse inequalities
findings.action: Both use rank formula c_k=b_k+r_k+r_(k+1); AT includes Q-flatness justification and DG allows any coefficient field

findings.subject: Distinct non-redundant content
